features.name: City switching and local content rebuilding
steps: Select a city such as Anshan/Shanghai
The home categories, business districts, search results, and booked merchants switch to the new city context
features.expected: After switching cities the top city must update; the home categories, business districts, search results, and booked merchants must all switch to the new city context; the switch must not leave any residual old-city data.

features.name: Domestic city / overseas city selection
steps: Locate a city by province, city, popular city, alphabetical index, or direct search
features.expected: After switching between domestic/overseas the city list changes correctly; switching works via province / popular / index / search; the selected city is correctly reflected.

features.name: Full multi-level category navigation
steps: Tap to enter the corresponding channel
features.expected: A first-level category must expand into the corresponding second- and third-level categories; when switching first-level categories the content is correctly replaced; tapping a specific category enters the corresponding channel with the correct filtering.

features.name: Popular category and business-district discovery
steps: The home page shows popular categories and business districts
Tap a category or business district
The corresponding channel and location filter conditions are formed automatically
features.expected: After tapping a popular category / business district the correct channel and location filter conditions must be formed; the merchant-list results match the conditions.

features.name: Browsing recommended home-page content
steps: Browse a mix of recommended content such as food, store visits, malls, and lifestyle
Tapping a content card enters the corresponding content/merchant
After returning, browsing continues from the original position
features.expected: The home page must show a mix of recommended content; tapping a content card enters the correct content/merchant; after returning, browsing continues from the original position; the content matches the preset.

features.name: Search by merchant name / address / dish name
steps: Enter keywords such as a merchant name, address, or dish name
After returning the keyword and search-result state are preserved
features.expected: Search results must match the keyword (merchant name / address / dish name); tapping a merchant opens the details; after returning the keyword and result state are preserved.

features.name: Channel search / site-wide search switching
steps: Currently in a channel such as attractions/food
Choose "channel search" to search only the current channel, or "site-wide search" to search across channels
features.expected: Channel search must return only the current channel's results; site-wide search returns across channels; the two modes' result sets are distinguishable; after switching, the query conditions are preserved.

features.name: Combined channel and category filtering
steps: Switch between channels such as food, hotels, entertainment, beauty, and attractions
features.expected: After switching channels the merchant set is recomputed; selecting a subcategory further narrows the results; the combined conditions take effect together.

features.name: Location / popular district / administrative district filtering
steps: Select location conditions such as a popular district / administrative district / subway line
The original channel conditions continue to be preserved
features.expected: The location conditions must correctly apply to the list; changing the location updates the list; the original channel conditions are preserved; combined conditions give correct results.

features.name: Group-buy / table-reservation filtering
steps: Only merchants matching the service capability are shown
After clearing the conditions the full results are restored
features.expected: After checking, only merchants matching the service capability are shown; unchecking restores the full results; the filter state is identifiable.

features.name: Merchant-list sort switching
steps: Switch between deterministic sorts such as top-rated, popularity, most reviews, total score, and per-capita spend
features.expected: After switching the sort mode the list order must be recomputed by the selected rule; the filter conditions stay unchanged; the sorted result matches the rule.

features.name: The no-results state and related-merchant recommendations
steps: The page enters the no-results state
Show related merchants according to the existing channel/location conditions
Tap a recommendation to continue browsing
features.expected: An overly narrow condition must enter a no-results state with a clear prompt; related-merchant recommendations are shown according to the existing conditions; tapping a recommendation continues browsing.

features.name: Merchant detail information aggregation
steps: Enter the merchant from the list
Aggregate and display information such as the merchant name, star rating, review count, taste/environment/service, category, business hours, tags, address, and photos
features.expected: The merchant name / star rating / review count / taste-environment-service / category / business hours / tags / address / photos must be fully displayed; the information is consistent with the list data.

features.name: Address / distance / phone service
steps: View the detailed address and distance information
Use the phone entry or location-related entries
Always keep the current merchant context
features.expected: The detailed address and distance are displayed correctly; the phone and location entries can be triggered normally; after the operation the current merchant context is always preserved.

features.name: Table reservation
steps: View the rating, taste/environment/service, and address
features.expected: The restaurant list correctly shows the rating / taste-environment-service / address; after selecting a merchant the correct reservation context is entered.

features.name: Coupons and discounted merchants are linked
steps: The merchant list shows states such as "discount" and "coupon"
After returning to the list the discount filter and merchant state are preserved
features.expected: The discount state is displayed correctly; after filtering only discounted merchants are shown; entering a merchant/discount and returning preserves the filter and state.

features.name: My reviews
steps: The user enters the personal center
View the corresponding merchant, star rating, body, photos, and time
Tap the merchant to reopen the details
features.expected: Historical reviews must be aggregated and displayed by time (merchant / star rating / body / photos / time); tapping the merchant reopens the detail page; the data is consistent.

features.name: Write a review
steps: Write a review from the merchant/order/profile page
The new review appears in "My reviews" and on the merchant's reviews
features.expected: After publishing, the new review must appear in "My reviews" and on the merchant's reviews page; the star rating / body / photos are saved correctly; the content must persist.

features.name: Liking and replying to reviews
steps: The reply is linked to the correct review
The state still exists when re-entering
features.expected: After liking, the count and state change; a reply must be linked to the correct review; the state still exists when re-entering; the data must persist.

features.name: Reviews linked to photos
steps: Add several photos when publishing a review
The photo is linked to the corresponding review and merchant
The review page shows the photos
It also appears on the personal "Photos" page
features.expected: Photos must be correctly linked to the corresponding review and merchant; the review page shows the photos; they also appear on the personal "Photos" page; the links are not lost.

features.name: My photos
steps: Aggregate the historically uploaded merchant photos
The corresponding personal photo list and related content change in sync
features.expected: Historical photos are correctly aggregated (by time / source); after deletion the personal photo list and related content change in sync; the operation must persist.

features.name: My favorites aggregated across types
steps: Switch between favorited merchants, posts, and reviews
Tapping the content returns to the original object
features.expected: Each type (merchant / post / review) is correctly categorized and displayed; tapping the content returns to the original object; switching types gives the correct results.

features.name: Favorite-merchant category and city filtering
steps: Filter by category such as food and by city such as Shenzhen/Xi'an
"Prefer merchants with discounts" can be checked
features.expected: Category and city filtering correctly apply to the favorites collection; after checking "prefer discounted" the results are sorted correctly; combined filters take effect.

features.name: The favorite and unfavorite states sync
steps: The favorite state must return to not-favorited in sync
features.expected: After unfavoriting from the favorites page the merchant page state must return to not-favorited in sync; the two states must always be consistent; the relationship must persist.

features.name: Check-in
steps: A check-in record containing time, merchant, and address is produced
The personal "Check-ins" are shown as a timeline
features.expected: After checking in, a record containing the time / merchant / address must be produced; the personal "Check-ins" are correctly displayed as a timeline; the record must persist.

features.name: Check-in reply interactions
steps: Expand the replies under a check-in record
The reply is linked to the current check-in
features.expected: After posting a reply it must be linked to the current check-in; it still exists after collapsing/re-entering; the reply content is displayed correctly.

features.name: Personal profile
steps: Aggregate the avatar, level, following, followers, likes received, registration time, reviews, check-ins, photos, and recent activity
The data across modules stays consistent
features.expected: Avatar / level / following / followers / likes received / registration time / reviews / check-ins / photos / recent activity must be correctly aggregated; the data across modules is consistent.

features.name: Recent activity
steps: The user performs actions such as writing a review, checking in, and favoriting/adding a merchant
The "Recent activity" feed automatically produces the corresponding behavior records
Tapping an activity enters the corresponding business object
features.expected: Each behavior (writing a review / check-in / favoriting, etc.) must automatically produce an activity record; sorted by time; tapping the activity enters the correct business object.

features.name: Following and personal statistics stay in sync
steps: One's own following count and list change
The profile statistics are consistent with the lists
features.expected: After following, the following count and the list change; the profile statistics are consistent with the lists; the likes-received data is displayed correctly.

features.name: Message-center state management
steps: The unread number on "Messages" at the top
The top number decreases in sync
features.expected: The preset messages make the top unread number display correctly; after opening a message the unread state changes; the top number decreases in sync.

features.name: Message category display
steps: Enter the message center (with preset messages of each type)
Switch between reminders, interactions, and subscriptions
Messages of different types enter the correct categories
After reading, the category counts and the total unread count update in sync
features.expected: Messages of each type enter the correct categories; after reading, the category counts and the total unread count update in sync; the category counts are consistent with the lists.

features.name: Message settings / ignore all / batch delete
steps: Multiple messages exist in the message center
Change message preferences or choose ignore-all/batch delete
The current list, category counts, and top message state change at the same time
features.expected: After changing preferences or performing batch operations the current list, category counts, and top state change at the same time; the operation result must persist.

features.name: The group-buy channel and group-buy categories
steps: Switch between the group-buy home, food, beauty, wedding, parenting, and home-decoration categories
Search or browse the corresponding group-buy product
features.expected: After switching categories the corresponding group-buy products are shown; the search/browse results are consistent with the category.

features.name: Group-buy orders and voucher-code state
steps: Generate one or more voucher codes
Show the quantity, amount, validity period, and transaction status
It can still be queried afterwards
features.expected: After generating an order the correct number of voucher codes must be generated; the quantity / amount / validity period / transaction status are displayed correctly; it can still be queried afterwards.

features.name: Group-buy vouchers / group-buy orders / new restaurant orders
steps: Switch between group-buy vouchers, group-buy orders, and new restaurant orders
The payment status, voucher code, expiry time, amount, and details follow their own business rules
features.expected: Each order type is correctly categorized and displayed; the payment status / voucher code / expiry time / amount / details follow their own business rules; switching types gives the correct results.

exclusions.feature:
The smart-sorting algorithm
The personalized ranking model behind the "Smart" sort
exclusions.reason: Smart sorting depends on an algorithmic model; deterministic sorts such as rating/popularity/review count are kept; retained surface: f11 merchant-list sort switching

exclusions.feature:
Real payment and transaction settlement
Payment gateways and fund flows
exclusions.reason: Depends on a payment system (cf. Taobao "real payment" exclusion); the order and voucher-code flow is localized (simulated payment)

exclusions.feature:
Real booking/reservation merchant-side confirmation
Merchant acceptance, confirmation, and arrival flow
exclusions.reason: Entering the reservation context and the form are testable; merchant-side confirmation and results use fixtures; retained surface: f15 table reservation

exclusions.feature:
Real merchant and review data
Real merchant information, ratings, and review content
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture merchants and review data (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of messages
Business events genuinely produce messages
exclusions.reason: The message state machine (unread/category/read/batch operations) is testable and requires preset message fixtures; retained surface: f30 message-center state management, f31 message category display, f32 message settings / ignore all / batch delete

exclusions.feature:
Changes on the other side of a follow
Changes in the other user's follower count and notifications they receive
exclusions.reason: The local following state is testable; the other side's data is presented via fixtures; retained surface: f29 following and personal statistics sync

exclusions.feature:
Real events of other users liking a review
Another user likes the review
exclusions.reason: The likes-received display is testable (preset); other users' liking behavior is not simulated; retained surface: f29 following and personal statistics sync

exclusions.feature:
Geolocation and real-time distance
Real-GPS-based distance calculation and in-store navigation
exclusions.reason: The distance display can use preset data; the navigation jump keeps its entry (cf. the treatment of Google Maps "real-time navigation")

exclusions.feature:
Real coupon redemption
In-store redemption and merchant verification flow
exclusions.reason: The coupon-code state display is testable; the real redemption flow depends on the merchant side; retained surface: f34 group-buy orders and coupon-code state

exclusions.feature:
Real phone dialing
The actual call behind a tel: link
exclusions.reason: The existence of the phone entry and context preservation are testable; real calls (browser/OS behavior) are not required; retained surface: f14 address / distance / phone service

exclusions.feature:
Real-time city operational data
Real merchant/group-buy/activity data per city
exclusions.reason: City switching and content rebuilding are testable (preset city dataset); full real-world data is not required; retained surface: f01 city switching and local content rebuilding

exclusions.feature:
Real in-store check-in verification
LBS-based in-store punch-in verification
exclusions.reason: Check-in records and the timeline are testable; real geolocation is not verified; retained surface: f25 check-in, f28 recent activity
